scope.summary: Implement the HBR matrix harness enforcing STU-VAL-006: every Studio WP/MT MUST carry the applicable HBR rows (INT/SWARM/VIS/QUIET/MAN/STOP) in its acceptance matrix, resolved to PROVED / NOT_APPLICABLE-with-reason / BLOCKED-with-cause; PASS closure is ILLEGAL while any required HBR row is PENDING/STEER/BLOCKED. The harness reads each MT's hbr[] + acceptance and blocks closure on unresolved rows.
acceptance_criteria: HBR matrix per WP/MT; rows resolved PROVED/NA/BLOCKED; PASS closure blocked on PENDING/STEER/BLOCKED
expected_tests: test: an MT with a PENDING required HBR row cannot reach PASS closure
test: matrix resolves each row to PROVED/NA-reason/BLOCKED-cause

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

risk_if_missed: MTs close PASS with unresolved HBR rows; harness-rule accountability lost.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
